stem: For B(1, −4) and C(−4, 3), plot the point Q dividing segment BC externally in the ratio 2:3.
solution: External division m=2, n=3: divide $n\cdot(\text{first})-m\cdot(\text{second})$ by $n-m$.

hints.text: x goes across, y goes up.
Check signs of the products you subtract.
External division subtracts in the numerator and the denominator.

notes: The y axis counts in twos.
